ST. BONAVENTURE MONASTERY CAPUCHIN FATHERS 1740 MT. ELLIOTT AVENUE DETROIT 7, MICHIGAN
Feb. 8th 1956
God bless you Lottie Nosewicz.
Pray to the good Lord for guidance, and to guide all concerned. If your Sisters and inlaws want to do something to promote justice and peace, they should join you in prayer for guideance while you consult a confessor, a priest. But you must turn a deaf ear to any other dictations.
You took care of your mother and dad through the grace of God, and God in His goodness arranged for you to have the homestead because of your kind- ness to your mother and Dad. So in all justice you should keep what the Good Lord arranged for you to have.
Praised be Jesus Christ Sincerely Yours in the Sacred Heart of Jesus and His blessed Mother.
Fr. Solanus O.F.M. Cap.
